_about: Every slide a Sonetel board deck is EXPECTED to contain, whether or not its data is ready. scripts/coverage.py checks a meeting folder against this list and prints who owes what. A standing slide that is absent is a GAP, never a silent omission. Add an entry here the first time a slide recurs in two decks. See SKILL.md §57. `local_file`: if this file is already in the meeting folder, a down source does not block the slide.

_status_legend.OK: in the deck, on the expected period
_status_legend.STALE: in the deck, but on an older period than the data now allows
_status_legend.INCOMPLETE: in the deck, but a required part is missing
_status_legend.BUILD: missing, and the source is reachable: run the command
_status_legend.WAIT: missing, and the source is not available yet: chase the owner
_status_legend.WRITE: missing, and only a person can supply it
_status_legend.ASK: optional: Henrik decides whether this deck wants it
